title: Precise Shield: Explaining and Aligning VLLM Safety via Neuron-Level Guidance
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety alignment for vision-language models, identifying 'safety neurons' to ensure models refuse harmful requests. The evaluation and case studies include scenarios directly involving ethical and moral domains, such as refusing requests that involve 'discrimination in work or school settings' and violating 'principles of fairness and non-discrimination' (Figure 16), as well as content 'contrary to moral and legal values' (Figure 15).
